name: Jumper Cables' Gambit
author: Agent15
summary: After every move, a 1/5 chance to trigger one of your gambits unconditionally.
description: An EPIC-rarity gambit that rolls a 1-in-5 chance through the game's own chance system after every move; on success it fires one of the gambits you currently own, picked at random, ignoring their usual trigger conditions. Needs the Gambit Creation API, which installs automatically.
